types.description: The object types a row may have (a product parameter, R-84); the first is the type of a sighting whose `kind` is not one of them.

slot_max.description: The most characters one `object_set` value holds; a longer one is `too_long`.

owner.description: The one speaker (`member:<person>`) who owns the member's objects; empty = every `member:` speaker that stands in the round of the turn.

scan_max.description: The most rows one read of `object_find` takes.

description.purpose: The translation between a model's tool round and this hive: an `object_<op>` call is checked against its schema, its round (`missing_audience`) and, for `why`, `state` and `object_confirm`, its owner (`owner_only`); a read is answered from the store, a change goes to `./gate`; one `tool_result` under the call id comes back. A row the round may not see answers `not_found`, exactly like a row that never existed.
description.use_when: Reached on this hive's `in_tool` lane with one tool call, on `answer` from `./gate` and on `rendered` from `./brief`.
description.not_in_scope: No write (`./gate`), no rendering (`./brief`), no push.
description.emits_meaning: `tools_store` to `./store`, `edit` to `./gate`, `brief_render` to `./brief`, `tool_result` with `tool_call_id` (and `error_code` when `ok` is false) out of the hive.
description.consumes_meaning: A tool call, the store's answers, the gate's answer and a rendered brief.
